records.title: Lovelock’s theorem revisited
records.pdf_internal_title_date: 2018-10-23 (distinct from arXiv version stamp; not treated as a new version)
records.authentication: official arXiv abstract submission history plus full primary PDF rendering/text
records.extraction: Read Definition1.1 p2, Definition1.8 p5, Corollary2.3 p7, Definition2.5/Theorem2.6 p9 and supporting argument. No local retained PDF yet.
records.result: For fixed-signature pseudo-Riemannian metrics in dimension n, symmetric smooth natural rank-two second-jet tensors with identically zero divergence form the real span of Lovelock tensors indexed0..floor((n-1)/2). In dimension4 this gives constant-coefficient dual metric and Einstein tensor.
records.application: Conditional theorem shape verified; project has not supplied the required puremetric second-jet/off-shell identity assumptions. No literal action uniqueness theorem inferred.

records.title: On second-order, divergence-free tensors
records.authentication: official arXiv abstract version stamp and primary PDF
records.extraction: Read introduction pp2-3, Definitions1.1-1.3 pp5-6, Definition5.1 and Theorem5.3 pp19-20 with proof and normalization.
records.result: Second-order means a smooth bundle map on metric2jets; natural means equivariance under local diffeomorphisms; divergence-free means the zero differential operator for all metrics. Theorem5.3 gives the Lovelock basis for rank-two tensors without assuming symmetry. Its L1 is proportional to Einstein tensor with dimension/signature normalization.
records.application: Confirms tensor classification and real constant coefficients; variable scalar coefficient or mixed scalar-metric operator is a different input object. No proof of framework adoption, health or Newtonian/lensing gates.
